name: Resonant Field background photograph
purpose: Generate a setting that remains legible behind the real translucent UI in dark and light modes.

variables.subject: A specific real-world subject or identifiable material
variables.perspective: Close-up, macro, underwater, upward view or landscape
variables.lighting: Soft natural light with restrained highlights
variables.reading_regions: The actual reading-panel regions of the selected workspace layout
variables.detail_regions: The exposed background areas around those panels
variables.material_cues: Physical details that make the subject recognisable

template: Create ONE photorealistic black-and-white background photograph of {subject}, seen from {perspective}. Show authentic {material_cues}, believable scale, optics and depth. Lighting: {lighting}. Mood: {mood}. Compose for a full-screen Resonant Field workspace: {reading_regions} need gentle tonal transitions and restrained local contrast; place the richer natural detail in {detail_regions}. Keep the subject recognisable, with quieter regions integrated naturally into the scene, not a blank artificial hole. Preserve useful composition when cropped to desktop, tablet and portrait. Wide 16:9. Use the highest supported native resolution, preferably 3840×2160; do not upscale a smaller image and claim it is native. Strict grayscale, equal RGB channels, no sepia or colored tint. Avoid clipped white glare, crushed black fields and repetitive high-contrast lines beneath text. No text, logo, people, interface, panes, rectangles, glass effects, diagram, border, artificial grain overlay or contact sheet. Generate only the photograph; the actual UI supplies color, translucency and blur.

delivery.resize_policy: Keep the largest native 16:9 crop, then downsample to the current cohort size; never enlarge to imply extra detail.
delivery.bitrate: Not applicable to still images; record actual bytes instead.
delivery.provenance: Save the exact final prompt, tool, actual native dimensions, source hash and date. Record unknown model versions as unknown.

acceptance: Recognisable subject or real material, distinct from existing plates
Full composition checked at 16:9, square and portrait crops
Actual reading panes checked in both dark and light mode
Bright details do not compete with text or focus indicators
Image is neutral; user hue, accent and optional complementary wash come from the material system
No generated UI or baked glass; original image retained separately from exports
